title: Evening traffic and safety

items.label: SR-17 NB · SR-9
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB SR-17 just south of SR-9 (Los Gatos / Campbell corridor), ~7:27 PM PT (CHP 2435). Unit assigned/enroute/at scene ~7:27. Detail log empty at check. Affects 17 travel from Campbell south.

items.label: US-101 NB → I-280
items.text: Unknown-injury collision that became a vehicle fire on the NB US-101 to NB I-280 connector, San Jose (~7:20–7:24 PM PT; CHP 2423 / related 2434). Gray Mazda 6 vs wall blocking the connector ramp; vehicle fully engulfed by ~7:23–7:29; fire notified. Affects 280 access.

upcoming: Overnight paving: SB SR-17 Hamilton Ave offramp right-turn lane starting ~9:01 PM PT tonight
cleared: SB SR-85 / Bascom Ave hit-and-run no-injury (CHP 2364; FSP 0179 closed ~7:23)
skipped: SB 101 JSO 87 hazard; Brokaw 101; Redwood City 92/101
East Bay; Marin / Solano; SF Cesar Chavez construction; Queens Ln CT assist
streets: Watch southbound Campbell exits onto NB 17 toward SR-9; avoid 101→280 connector if possible.
